about_the_game:
"It's Ironic how much you hate robots considering you're at least 70% necrobots by now. Every time one of us brings you back you get a little less human."

Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy. 

X has watched the job postings dwindle as mercenary's are replaced by androids. After death number 74 while working as a bodyguard for a necromancer (one of the few people left to hire human bodyguards) X decided to start learning a new career.

NecroMerc is a twist on the classic FPS genre with RPG necromancy mechanics. You might be shooting enemies while also summoning skeletons.

It's set in a futuristic setting where you play on different planets as well as on space stations. The environments are a mix of sci-fi, cyberpunk, and horror. You get to choose missions and travel to different worlds.

The demo includes only a couple of missions, one type of bullet, one type of summon, and limited enemies. The full game will include substantially more content, more settings, more missions, more bullets, more summons, more enemies, more environments, more worlds, and more story content.

content_descriptors.notes:
The mature content in the demo is skeletons exploding in an unrealistic way. 

There are some mature themes though about bringing people back from the dead in the plot being as the main character is an out of work mercenary becoming a necromancer.  One of the missions in the demo could come across as an assassination mission. Another is about destroying medical/scientific waste which is attacking people in the form of skeletons.
